narr: Storms developed along a weak surface boundary with anomalously high moisture over the area. Multiple outflows collided over the Columbia Metro leading to flash flooding.
ev: USGS Rocky Branch at Whaley St gage rose above flood stage, cresting at 12.90 feet at 6:27PM, exceeding the previous max crest. The Five Points area in Columbia had the most significant flooding with multiple vehicles submerged requiring multiple rescues. Water also entered apartments in the St. Andrews area. A mesonet site at MLK Park reported 4.09 inches of rain in one hour.
